nary_nodes.label: France excess deaths
evidence: France has said it recorded an increase of more than 2,000 deaths during the last week of a record-breaking European heatwave in June
In France, the number of deaths recorded between 22 and 28 June increased by 2,025

nary_nodes.label: European heatwave
evidence: Europe braces for more extreme weather

nary_nodes.label: Further extreme temperatures forecast
evidence: forecasters warn of further extreme temperatures on the continent in the next few days
parts of Europe, including the UK, braced for more searing temperatures from this weekend

nary_nodes.label: France death rate increase
evidence: Deaths rose 29% in the last week of June compared to the week before

nary_nodes.label: Clear increase in deaths over 45
evidence: French health minister Stéphanie Rist adding there had been a "clear increase" in deaths among those over 45

nary_nodes.label: France's hottest day ever
evidence: France saw its hottest day ever on average country-wide on 24 June

nary_nodes.label: Half of France under red heat alert
evidence: half the nation placed under a red heat alert

nary_nodes.label: High pressure building
evidence: BBC Weather says a large area of high pressure is currently building from the Azores towards Portugal and Spain and that by the weekend, heat is forecast to climb across France and southern Britain

nary_nodes.label: Americans affected by extreme heat
evidence: millions of Americans celebrating the July Fourth holiday weekend are already being affected by prolonged extreme heat and high humidity in parts of the central and eastern US

nary_nodes.label: Climate change driving temperatures
evidence: Climate change is driving up temperatures around the world - but particularly in Europe. It is the fastest warming continent, heating up twice as fast as the global average, according to the Copernicus climate service.

nary_nodes.label: Belgium excess deaths
evidence: Belgium recorded 1,222 excess deaths during the heatwave

nary_nodes.label: Belgium deaths over 85
evidence: almost half being people aged 85 and over

nary_nodes.label: Belgium deaths unprecedented
evidence: The country's health ministry said the number of deaths during a heatwave was "unprecedented"

nary_nodes.label: France excess deaths (Public Health)
evidence: In France, the number of deaths recorded between 22 and 28 June increased by 2,025

nary_nodes.label: Paris region death rate increase
evidence: Deaths rose by 62% in the Paris region alone

nary_nodes.label: Death figure an underestimate
evidence: The French health ministry said the figure was likely an "underestimate" and mortality would "therefore be higher than these initial figures"

nary_nodes.label: Drowning deaths
evidence: Drowning deaths soared during the heatwave, with French Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez saying on Saturday that 72 people had died by drowning since 18 June

nary_nodes.label: Netherlands excess deaths
evidence: unprecedented heat in the Netherlands last week led to about 480 excess deaths

nary_nodes.label: Netherlands deaths over 80
evidence: most of whom were aged 80 and older

nary_nodes.label: Netherlands peak temperature
evidence: Temperatures reached almost 40C in parts of the country

nary_nodes.label: Hot weather predicted elsewhere
evidence: While the Netherlands is expecting a cooler week ahead, hot weather is predicted again over the weekend elsewhere.

nary_nodes.label: South France temperature forecast
evidence: Temperatures are forecast to reach 40C in the south of France, with peaks of 36C to 37C expected around Bordeaux, Toulouse and Agen.

nary_nodes.label: Météo-France red alerts for fires
evidence: Météo-France has issued red alerts for Friday and Saturday for forest fires in the southern part of the country

nary_nodes.label: Very high fire risk
evidence: warning that weather conditions meant the risk of an outbreak was "very high" compared to summer norms

nary_nodes.label: Fires since summer start
evidence: Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu said nearly 7,000 fires had broken out since the start of the summer season

nary_nodes.label: People evacuated due to wildfire
evidence: Nearly 3,000 people were evacuated after a wildfire ignited in the town of Sainte-Marie-la-Mer and spread to Canet-en-Roussillon on Thursday

nary_nodes.label: Another heatwave possibility
evidence: Aemet weather service has warned of the possibility of another heatwave

nary_nodes.label: Portugal state of alert
evidence: Portugal's government declared a state of alert which will remain in place until midnight on Tuesday

nary_nodes.label: Portugal temperature forecast
evidence: Temperatures are forecast to exceed 40C in some areas, with overnight temperatures above 25C

nary_nodes.label: Spain orange alert
evidence: In Spain, areas of the southwest are on orange alert as 40C is expected in some parts

nary_nodes.label: Anglian Water situation changing
evidence: Anglian Water says the situation is changing very quickly with another heatwave forecast

nary_nodes.label: UKHSA risks may increase
evidence: The UK Health Security Agency says risks may increase when temperatures soar from Wednesday
